# Behind the Name

> > Behind the Name is a comprehensive etymology and statistics database covering given names and surnames from around the world.

The site provides detailed name meanings, origins, popularity rankings, and cultural information across multiple countries including the United States, England, Wales, Spain, Argentina, Belgium, Croatia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Netherlands, Norway, and Poland. It offers both historical context and current naming trends with statistical data.

## Key Topics

- Name etymology and meanings
- Surname statistics and rankings
- Baby name popularity trends
- Regional name variations
- Name days and saint celebrations
- Global surname distributions
- Historical name origins
- Cultural naming traditions
- International name databases
- Given name statistics
- Common surnames by country
- Name pronunciation guides
- Alphabetical name references

## Popular Names & Rankings

- [Popular Names in England and Wales 2024](http://www.behindthename.comwww.behindthename.com/top/lists/england-wales/2024): Top 1000 baby names in England and Wales for 2024 from National Statistics

## Surname Statistics & Research

- [The Most Common Surnames](https://surnames.behindthename.com/top/): Global surname rankings from US, Argentina, Belgium, Croatia, England & more

## Cultural Name Traditions

- [Spanish Name Days](http://www.behindthename.comwww.behindthename.com/namedays/country/spain): Annual calendar of Spanish saint name days and celebrations

## External Resources

- [Browse Websites](http://www.behindthename.comwww.behindthename.com/external/browse.php?letter=b): Alphabetical directory of external name resources starting with letter B
